where.zh: 水果廣場（也是速食街的背景音樂）
where.en: Fruit Plaza (also used for Fast Food Street)

harness.notes: js/audio.js is a standalone ES module exporting sfx and music, no imports, no DOM. Called from js/main.js loadWorld(id) and startGame() as music.play(G.wid). Settings save.music/save.sound default on.

notes: Each song = 4-bar chord progression (16 beats, loopSec = 16*60/bpm: 112/120/92/128/100 bpm) with a seeded-random plucky melody on top; the seeded RNG restarts at each play() but the module-level bar counter does not, so render each song on a fresh page. The melody does not repeat exactly every loop. World 'fastfood' has no own song (SONGS fallback to plaza).
